items.excerpt: Two weeks have already passed since my return from Cupertino and San Francisco, and only now can I fully process all the thoughts and emotions of #WWDC26. Time flies, especially after such an intense and stimulating event! It was great to connect with familiar faces and meet new professionals to discuss not only the Apple ecosystem, but also the broader challenges and opportunities shaping different industries. In particular, I found the conversations about agentic commerce extremely stimulating. The future of digital commerce is increasingly leaning toward personalized, AI-driven experiences. WWDC26 confirmed this trend through the direction taken with SiriAI and the massive focus on App Intents and Foundation Models. I am convinced we will see incredible innovations in this area in the coming years. And what an incredible highlight it was to see our own apps featured on the big screen at Apple Park! That was a proud milestone for the whole team back home. Coming back with fresh ideas, sharp insights, and ready to build what's next!

In the coming days, I’ll be heading back to Cupertino and San Francisco to attend the WWDC 2026. I’m excited to have the opportunity to join the event once again, back to back, especially in a year that marks the 50th anniversary of #Apple. I’m looking forward to discover what’s next for the Apple ecosystem and exchanging ideas on how emerging technologies can create value for real products and businesses.
If you’ll be attending, I’d love to connect with fellow developers, product owners, and digital professionals working in e-commerce and mobile apps, particularly those exploring AI-driven experiences, personalization, and other innovations shaping the future of digital commerce.
Always happy to grab a coffee and have a chat, see you there!

A couple of weeks ago I had the incredible opportunity to give a talk at the Create with Swift Napoli Meetup #3, together with my colleagues Marco Tammaro and Oreste Leone: “Collaborating at Scale: Developer stories from consulting”.We shared insights, real-world examples, and actionable strategies for writing scalable code, improving team workflows, and navigating fast-paced projects. Sharing…
items.note: Grateful for the experience and the conversations that followed. Thanks to everyone who joined and to the Create with Swift team for making it happen, looking forward to the next one!

items.excerpt: Thank you to everyone who joined us yesterday for our Naples Meetup #3 at Spazio Tra!We were thrilled to host four amazing speakers who shared their valuable experiences and insights. The conversations, connections, and energy in the room made for an unforgettable event. ✨
